g.text: SimpleStories-V2-5M • released baseline • controllers, private buses, memories and multiplier resources

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 20.16px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #172f46

g.text: 90 mapped multipliers = 64 projection + 2 projection-scaling + 19 runtime-role + 5 supporting units

text.style: font-size: 15.12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52687a

g.text: The 19 runtime-role units are included in the 90. Both operands are runtime values in at least one scheduled role; the units are not user-programmable.

g.text: 1 Follow the data through the chip

g.text: Copy → seal → SHA-256 digest check → use.

text.style: font-size: 14.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #172f46

g.text: Expected digests are fixed inside the circuit.

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52687a
font-weight: 700; font-size: 15.84px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #172f46
font-size: 14.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #172f46

g.text: Stores and fetches past keys and values (K/V).

text.style: font-size: 14.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #172f46

g.text: Owns row staging, valid prefix and addresses.

text.style: font-size: 14.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #172f46

g.text: Baseline K/V data have no integrity check.

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52687a
font-weight: 700; font-size: 15.84px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #c57516
font-size: 12.96px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #172f46

g.text: An integrity guard is inserted on this path.

text.style: font-size: 12.96px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #172f46

g.text: It checks K/V against private expected digests.

text.style: font-size: 12.96px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #172f46

g.text: It is outside the baseline count shown here.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16.56px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #172f46

g.text: Shared DDR arbiter + runtime memory adapter

text.style: font-size: 14.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #172f46

g.text: Combines model reads and typed K/V reads / writes while retaining transaction ownership.

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52687a
font-weight: 700; font-size: 16.56px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #172f46
font-size: 14.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #172f46

g.text: 25 MHz inference control ↔ 100 MHz DDR application interface; 400 MHz PHY clock source.

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52687a
font-weight: 700; font-size: 16.56px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #172f46
font-size: 14.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #172f46

g.text: Separate address regions: fixed model image (~7.3 MB) and mutable attention cache (~7.1 MB).

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 19.44px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #2867aa
font-size: 14.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #172f46

g.text: Used for Q/K/V projections, output projection, the feed-forward network and the vocabulary head.

text.style: font-size: 13.68px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52687a

g.text: The controller reuses the same hardware across all layers; it does not select a general matrix program.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16.56px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #172f46
font-size: 14.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #172f46

g.text: One signed 16-bit value, broadcast to every lane.
